label: Slack: React
description: Add (or remove) an emoji reaction on a message, addressed by channel + ts. The usual acknowledgement pattern: react to the message a workflow just handled.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the reactions:write scope.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: The channel id the message lives in

inputs.name: remove
inputs.label: Remove instead of add
inputs.description: Take the reaction off instead of adding it.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the reaction change landed.
